Select: [chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles]
Source: [molecule_dictionary, compound_records, compound_structures, docs]
Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno AND compound_records.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123873') AND compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter: compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
Sort: chembl_id ASC, compound_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC
Limit: None
